### About Maksudur Rahman
I am a seasoned PHP Software Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, and the founder/lead engineer behind **Kodersolution.com** with over 5 years of professional experience crafting high-throughput, secure, and scalable web applications. My core expertise centers around modern Laravel (10/11), PHP 8.x, database optimization (MySQL/PostgreSQL/Redis), payment gateway integrations, RESTful API design, and Next.js / React user interfaces.

Throughout my career in rapid-growth tech companies and enterprise projects, I have architected payment routing engines handling thousands of daily checkouts, built HRM & Payroll systems handling complex shift and tax logic, engineered offline-first Point of Sale platforms, and created full-stack platforms serving active developer communities.

I adhere strictly to PSR standards, SOLID principles, Clean Architecture paradigms, and secure coding practices (column-level encryption, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and Sanctum/Passport auth).

## 4. Portfolio Projects (Detailed Case Studies)

### 1. Kodersolution.com - Developer Platform (Flagship Venture)
- **Case Study URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/kodersolution/
- **Live Platform URL**: https://kodersolution.com
- **Role**: Founder & Lead Engineer | **Category**: Developer Platform | **Type**: Personal Venture | **Duration**: 2023 - Present
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router, SSR, ISR), Laravel 10/11 REST API, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, Redis, Docker
- **Overview**: An interactive developer learning platform and educational ecosystem engineered to share high-quality technical articles, programming tutorials, student learning tracks, and real-time community forums covering Laravel, React, and system architecture.
- **Key Challenges**: Handling concurrent student forum discussions; optimizing full-text searches across thousands of articles; maximizing SEO indexing; automated split-payment billing for course authors.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Implemented a hybrid Next.js SSR/ISR rendering pipeline backed by Laravel REST APIs (`api.kodersolution.com`); built Redis caching layers for instant search responses; configured structured JSON-LD schemas and dynamic metadata pipelines; designed signed URL generation for secure digital asset downloads.
- **Impact**: Serving thousands of monthly developer readers with sub-second page loads, real-time forum discussions, and fast article searches.

### 2. Peaklancer Freelance Marketplace
- **URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/peaklancer/
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer | **Category**: Marketplace | **Type**: Client | **Duration**: 2024 (6 months)
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, Livewire, MySQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS
- **Overview**: A modern freelance services marketplace facilitating digital gig listings, custom proposals, escrow payments, milestone tracking, and direct chat.
- **Key Challenges**: Building a multi-currency escrow payment engine with secure holdings and release checks; instant chat messaging; commission calculations.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Designed an automated double-entry payment escrow pipeline; integrated WebSockets and Redis channels for real-time chat; built admin governance modules for dispute resolution.
- **Impact**: Delivered a seamless digital marketplace supporting client-freelancer contracts and zero-loss payment escrow.

### 3. Payment Gateway Integration Service
- **URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/payment-gateway/
- **Role**: Lead Developer | **Category**: Fintech | **Type**: Company | **Duration**: 2023 - Present
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Redis, Docker
- **Overview**: A high-volume transaction routing engine connecting payment checkouts with banking networks, featuring webhook sequencing and reconciliation.
- **Key Challenges**: Lock contention and duplicate payment callbacks under heavy traffic; non-standard bank API responses; out-of-order webhooks.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Implemented Redis distributed locks to prevent duplicate callback processing; built adapter normalization layers; enforced transactional state queue logs.
- **Impact**: Handled thousands of daily checkouts with 0% duplicate payment rates and under 200ms routing latency.

### 4. School ERP Portal
- **URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/school/
- **Role**: Software Engineer | **Category**: Education | **Type**: Client | **Duration**: 2025 - Present
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Livewire, Alpine.js
- **Overview**: An all-in-one school management portal covering student registration, class schedules, attendance tracking, and report card generation.
- **Key Challenges**: High-volume PDF report generation causing timeouts; schedule conflict matrices; slow profile history loads.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Offloaded PDF generation tasks to Redis background queue workers; built custom conflict-checking schedule algorithms; optimized eager-loading relationships.
- **Impact**: Reduced end-of-term report processing overhead from days to hours across multiple institutions.

### 5. HRM & Payroll Engine
- **URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/hrm/

- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, MySQL, jQuery, Bootstrap
- **Overview**: A payroll-focused HRM engine handling work shift rules, salary calculation, tax deductions, and employee records.
- **Key Challenges**: Custom overtime and tax calculation rules; encrypting payroll data while maintaining searchability; slow report queries.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Built dynamic payroll calculation formula engines; implemented column-level AES encryption with blind index search; created materialized query views.
- **Impact**: Eliminated manual payroll errors and reduced overall payroll processing time by 75%.

### 6. Garments ERP Supply Chain System

### 7. Point of Sale (POS) Offline Register
- **URL**: https://maksudur.dev/projects/pos/
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer | **Category**: Inventory System | **Type**: Company | **Duration**: 2021 - 2022
- **Tech Stack**: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, jQuery
- **Overview**: A retail cash register platform that operates offline during internet dropouts and automatically synchronizes local transactions upon reconnection.
- **Key Challenges**: Syncing offline sales with central inventory without data corruption; low-latency hardware performance; browser hardware printer interfacing.
- **Engineering Solutions**: Engineered a local-first browser IndexedDB event queue; optimized render loops for low-spec PCs; built custom client printing drivers using native browser APIs.
- **Impact**: Maintained 99.9% inventory sync accuracy across retail store branches.

### 8. Money Management Financial Ledger
